name: Employee
description: Self-service: a person's own record, time, requests and payslips.

name: Supervisor
description: Own record, plus reports' attendance and leave.

name: L1 Manager
description: Direct manager an attendance or leave approval routes to.

name: Senior Management
description: Reads payroll; does not administer HR.

name: HQ Payroll HR
description: Prepares payroll and reviews claims; may not commit a run.

name: Manager (HR Controller)
description: Line manager who also prepares payroll.
